## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Tángmì recitation-manual (*yíguǐ* 儀軌) for the **Cintāmaṇi-cakra Avalokiteśvara** translated by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) under the senior-court titles 開府儀同三司特進試鴻臚卿肅國公食邑三千戶賜紫贈司空諡大鑒正號大廣智大興善寺三藏沙門. The work belongs to the Tángmì *yíguǐ* triad on the Cintāmaṇi-cakra ([KR6j0292](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0292), [KR6j0293](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0293)) that supplements the four earlier *dhāraṇī-sūtra* recensions ([KR6j0287](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0287)–[KR6j0290](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0290)).

**Abstract**

The opening — "依灌頂道場經，說脩陀羅尼法門" — is identical to that of the Sahasrabhuja recitation-manual [KR6j0272](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0272), grounding the practice in the *Guàndǐng dàocháng* (Abhiṣeka-maṇḍala) framework. The procedure unfolds in the standard Tángmì sequence: bodhicitta + *saṃvara*, abhiṣeka, maṇḍala-visualisation, self-generation as Cintāmaṇi-cakra Avalokiteśvara, recitation of the *mūla-mantra* and supporting *vidyā* with the corresponding mudrās, *homa*, and dedication. The work is the most systematically Esoteric of the Tang Cintāmaṇi-cakra texts and represents the *yoga-tantra* approach to the deity, distinct from the more popular *dhāraṇī-sūtra* genre of [KR6j0287](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0287)–[KR6j0290](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0290).
